C0753.title: U.S. Critical Infrastructure Cyber Incident Reporting Act of 2022
C0753.summary: In 2022, the U.S. enacted the Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act (CIRCIA), requiring entities in critical infrastructure sectors to report cyber incidents to CISA within 72 hours. The act aims to strengthen critical infrastructure cybersecurity, and failure to comply with such reporting obligations constitutes a compliance risk.
